summary: Restore iFood-specific merchant discovery, catalog search, quote, session inspection, and preview-first cart orchestration commands after canonical generation.
reason: The browser-sniffed OpenAPI surface does not express the cross-endpoint aggregation and safety policy required by an agent-ready grocery workflow.
validated_outcome: The restored commands use the current generated error-classification contract, publish executable help examples, are covered by unit fixtures, and preserve dry-run and explicit-confirmation behavior for cart writes.
